title: Add stale-finding SLA to JOB-SEC-001 to prevent findings ageing without disposition
summary: JOB-SEC-001 is detecting but not closing recurring issues. SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02 are 9+ days open with no disposition. A stale-finding SLA rule is needed.
body: Jobs Review (2026-03-16) found JOB-SEC-001 is generating findings without closing them. SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 (trust_model.multi_user_heuristic) and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02 (non-elevated PF posture) both 9+ days open. Required: define stale-finding SLA; add to JOB-SEC-001 definition; apply retroactively to stale findings.
proposed_action: Define stale-finding SLA for JOB-SEC-001 and force disposition of 2 stale findings
